referenceUse: User-supplied battle screenshots were inspected for floor/backdrop composition only; they are not shipped. Initial 12 variants use the generated Aurelion painting as a style reference. Secondary and Warden scenes are distinct new generations with the same written style specification.
packing: Original PNG copied intact to assets-src/arenas/0.213; nativeImage.toJPEG(88) for production, no crop/recolour/scene edits. Responsive crop occurs in the renderer.

assets.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Production environment painting for the original card-battle game Shattered Rifts. A single seamless wide 16:9 LANDSCAPE image, ideally 2048x1152. Complete arena backdrop AND floor painted together, no UI or characters. Camera is at the side of a broad fighting area, looking gently downward, not overhead: the distant architecture occupies the top 52 percent; the walkable ground runs uninterrupted from about y=52 percent to the bottom edge and from left edge to right edge. Floor large worn irregular stones in shallow perspective with rich painterly texture, broad calm low-contrast areas for character silhouettes at x=20 percent and x=70 percent, their feet around y=70 percent. No floating square platform, no black or empty side margins, no giant circular stage, no checkerboard or texture-tile repetition. Structures physically meet the ground; coherent believable architecture at the perimeter, no random prop collection. A thin jagged branching magical fissure in the floor near y=76 percent supplies a rich luminous accent and nearby reflected light without obscuring actors. Deep layered atmosphere with premium dramatic lighting, bold readable hand-painted shapes, crisp angular brushwork and softly outlined architecture, matching the supplied Shattered Rifts artwork's polished illustrated fantasy style, not photorealistic, not 3D rendering, not a rough sketch. No people, enemies, lettering, text, HUD, cards, watermarks or border. Reference image is for the realm's established art style, palette and architectural motifs ONLY; completely recompose it as a close, cohesive battle location with substantial walls behind the actors and a continuous floor. Scene: Aurelion palace outer court, warm ivory and weathered blue-grey flagstone, tall gilded buttresses and royal blue sun banners attached to real stonework. A left colonnade looks over layered pale spires and an amber sunset; on the right a monumental recessed arched royal door with a sun motif and golden light inside. Strong asymmetry and real depth, not a symmetrical postcard skyline. Intact stone balustrade across the rear of the combat ground at mid-height. Warm golden key light, cool blue shadows, restrained amber-gold rift fissure. At the two extreme foreground corners only, cropped low stone bases with worn carved edges, not black framing masses. Keep the floor's foreground under the card hand relatively quiet.
